sections.title: Website ownership & intellectual property
body: This website and all associated technology, design, content management systems, and backend infrastructure are owned and operated by RSP Management Solutions LLC.

RSP Management Solutions LLC provides technical services for this website, including but not limited to: payment processing, content management, hosting, marketing, SEO, design, backend development, ticketing systems, merchandise storefront development, inventory management, social media design, community management, CRM, and analytics.

RSP Management Solutions LLC maintains exclusive ownership and claim over all underlying intellectual property, including but not limited to: website code, software, databases, proprietary systems, design elements, trademarks (including "Still Got It Collective"™), and technical implementations. All rights reserved.
For inquiries regarding intellectual property or technical services, please contact RSP Management Solutions LLC through the contact page.

sections.title: Terms & conditions
body: Attendance at Still Got It Collective events is subject to venue policies, age restrictions, and any posted house rules. Tickets are generally non-refundable unless an event is cancelled or rescheduled; in those cases, refund details will be communicated via the ticketing platform.

sections.title: Privacy
body: We use analytics to understand how people find and use this site, and may collect basic contact details when you purchase tickets or merch. We do not sell your data. For questions about how your information is used, please reach out on the contact page.
